label: Functional cosmetics review
kw: Functional cosmetics review agent in Korea
answer: Functional cosmetics review (기능성화장품 심사) is the procedure in which cosmetics manufacturers, cosmetics responsible distributors and others that want to sell cosmetics claiming effects set by the Cosmetics Act (화장품법), such as whitening, wrinkle improvement or UV protection, have each product reviewed for safety and efficacy by the President of the National Institute of Food and Drug Safety Evaluation (식품의약품안전평가원장); in cases such as products identical to a published item, a report is submitted instead of a review. When you submit the review request with data on origin and development history, safety, efficacy, and specifications and test methods, the processing period is 60 days. YouSun Administrative Agency prepares and files functional cosmetics review requests and reports on your behalf.

services.name: Preparing and filing the functional cosmetics review (기능성화장품 심사) request
Preparing and filing the report for items excluded from review (심사 제외 품목 보고)
Checking whether the product falls within the 11 functional cosmetics categories (기능성화장품의 범위)
Determining whether the product requires review or only a report
Organizing the list of required data and checking which data may be waived (자료 제출 생략)
Preparing and filing an amended review (변경심사) request
Re-filing a report when a submitted report changes
Preparing amended review documents for a transfer of rights
Guidance on whether cosmetics responsible distributor registration (화장품책임판매업 등록) is needed first
Handling supplement requests during the review

clients: Cosmetics responsible distributors launching new whitening or anti-wrinkle products
Importing responsible distributors bringing functional products from abroad to sell in Korea
Cosmetics manufacturers making functional products with their own formulations
Universities and research institutes with functional research results

glance.label: Who needs it
glance.value: Cosmetics manufacturers, cosmetics responsible distributors, and universities, research institutes and laboratories that want products recognized and sold as functional cosmetics

glance.label: Requirements
glance.value: The effect falls within the 11 functional cosmetics categories; the raw materials and quantities are justified by the data and the purpose of the formulation is recognized; the efficacy claims fit the category; the dosage and administration are clear with no room for misuse

glance.label: Process
glance.value: Category check → review or report decision → data preparation → submission of the review request or report → review → issuance of the result notice or entry in the report register → amended review or re-report when changes occur

glance.label: Documents
glance.value: Functional cosmetics review request or report for items excluded from review; origin and development history data; safety data; efficacy or function data; evidence for setting the SPF and PA (UVA protection grade) for UV protection products; specifications and test methods data (including samples)

glance.label: Timeline
glance.value: Review request 60 days; reports and amended reviews depend on confirmation by the National Institute of Food and Drug Safety Evaluation and any supplements

chooser.label: The product uses published ingredients exactly as notified
Changing a product that has already been reviewed

situations.q: A buyer is asking for our functional cosmetics certificate in Korea. What document should we provide?
situations.conclusion: The Cosmetics Act has no functional cosmetics "certification" scheme. If the product was reviewed, the evidence is the functional cosmetics review or amended review result notice; if it was reported, it is the entry in the report register. Give the buyer the result notice or report record for that product.

branches.when: The product was reviewed
branches.then: Provide the review or amended review result notice issued by the President of the National Institute of Food and Drug Safety Evaluation.

branches.when: The product is subject to a report
branches.then: Provide the report record showing the report number and report date.

branches.when: The product has not yet been reviewed or reported
branches.then: Complete the product's review or report before making any functional claim.

situations.docs: Functional cosmetics review or amended review result notice, or report record
situations.period: Review request 60 days / reports are entered in the register after the requirements are confirmed

situations.q: Does a whitening cream made with the published ingredients and concentrations still need a functional cosmetics review in Korea?
situations.conclusion: If the type and content of the active ingredient, the efficacy claims, the dosage and administration, and the specifications and test methods are all the same as an item published by the Minister of Food and Drug Safety (식품의약품안전처장), you submit a report instead of a review. If any of them differs, the product is subject to review.

branches.when: All four items match the published item
branches.then: Submit the report for items excluded from review to the President of the National Institute of Food and Drug Safety Evaluation.

branches.when: The content, dosage and administration or another item differs from the published item
branches.then: Obtain a review by submitting the review request with safety and efficacy data and other materials.

situations.docs: Report for items excluded from review or review request; formulation data; specifications and test methods data
situations.period: Review 60 days / reports are entered in the register after the requirements are confirmed

situations.q: To launch a sunscreen as a functional cosmetic in Korea, do we need SPF and PA test data?
situations.conclusion: A UV protection product undergoing review must submit evidence for setting its SPF and UVA protection grade (PA). However, products with published ingredients and concentrations may omit this data, and a product identical in all respects to an already reviewed item is handled by report.

branches.when: You seek review for a new formulation
branches.then: Submit the review request including the evidence for setting the SPF and UVA protection grade.

branches.when: Raw materials, content, specifications, dosage and formulation are the same as an already reviewed item
branches.then: If the measured SPF is within minus 20 percent, it is treated as the same efficacy and you submit a report.

situations.docs: Review request or report; evidence for setting the SPF and UVA protection grade; specifications and test methods data
situations.period: Review 60 days / in practice, time to prepare test data comes first

situations.q: Can an anti-hair-loss shampoo ever be sold as a functional cosmetic in Korea by report rather than review?
situations.conclusion: For a hair-loss relief functional cosmetic to be subject to a report on the ground that it is identical to an already reviewed item, the existing item must have had its efficacy proven by a comparative test against a control group. Otherwise it is subject to review.

branches.when: Ingredients, content and other items all match a published item
branches.then: Handle it as a report of a published item.

branches.when: The product makes hair look thicker physically, for example by coating
branches.then: It is excluded from the hair-loss relief functional cosmetics category, so it cannot be claimed as functional.

situations.docs: Review request or report; efficacy data (efficacy tests and human application tests); specifications and test methods data

situations.q: How long should we allow for a functional cosmetics review in Korea to meet our launch schedule?
situations.conclusion: The processing period for a review request is 60 days. Time to produce safety and efficacy test data and to respond to supplement requests is separate, so build that margin into the launch schedule.

branches.when: The product is subject to a report
branches.then: It is entered in the report register after the requirements are confirmed, without review, so the preparation burden is lighter than for a review.

branches.when: The product is subject to review
branches.then: Plan the schedule as test data preparation → review request → 60-day review → result notice.

situations.docs: Review request; data on origin and development history, safety, efficacy, and specifications and test methods
situations.period: Statutory: review 60 days / in practice, test data preparation and supplement time are added

situations.q: We are concerned about functional cosmetics review costs. Are there cases where a report is enough?
situations.conclusion: A report is submitted instead of a review for functional cosmetics identical to a published item, items identical in all respects to an already reviewed item, and items combining reviewed UV protection ingredients with published whitening or anti-wrinkle ingredients. Even for products under review, items with published ingredients and concentrations may omit the origin, safety, efficacy and UV protection evidence data.

branches.when: The product falls under one of the three report cases
branches.then: Submit the report for items excluded from review.

branches.when: The item's specifications and test methods are published
branches.then: You may omit the specifications and test methods data.

situations.docs: Report for items excluded from review or review request; the required data that cannot be waived
situations.period: Review 60 days / reports are entered in the register after the requirements are confirmed

situations.q: If I hire an administrative agent for a functional cosmetics review in Korea, what will they handle?
situations.conclusion: With your written authorization, an administrative agent checks whether the product falls within the functional categories and whether it needs review or a report, organizes the list of required data, prepares the review request or report, files it with the National Institute of Food and Drug Safety Evaluation and responds to supplements. The agent does not design or conduct toxicity, efficacy or human application tests, interpret results, set specifications and test methods, or design efficacy claims.

branches.when: Test data is already available
branches.then: The agent organizes the data to meet form requirements and submits it with the review request.

branches.when: No test data is available
branches.then: Have a testing laboratory carry out the tests first, then prepare the submission documents from the results.

situations.docs: Letter of authorization; cosmetics responsible distributor or manufacturer registration details; formulation data; test reports
situations.period: Review 60 days / the outcome is decided by the National Institute of Food and Drug Safety Evaluation

situations.q: If we import a functional product already sold overseas, does it need a new review in Korea?
situations.conclusion: To sell a product as a functional cosmetic in Korea, each product must be reviewed by the President of the National Institute of Food and Drug Safety Evaluation or covered by a report. Imported products follow the same standards, and cosmetics responsible distributor registration is needed first for distribution in Korea.

branches.when: Ingredients, content and other items match a Korean published item
branches.then: Handle it by submitting a report.

branches.when: The formulation differs from the Korean published items
branches.then: Organize the overseas test data to meet Korean submission requirements and obtain a review.

situations.docs: Review request or report; data on origin and development history, safety and efficacy; specifications and test methods data (including samples)
situations.period: Review 60 days / in practice, time to organize overseas data is added

situations.q: How do we apply for a dual-function product claiming both whitening and UV protection in Korea?
situations.conclusion: An item that combines the ingredients and content of an already reviewed UV protection functional cosmetic with published whitening or anti-wrinkle ingredients and content, and in which raw materials, efficacy, specifications, dosage and formulation are all the same, is subject to a report. Other combinations require review.

branches.when: You add published whitening or anti-wrinkle ingredients to a reviewed UV protection formulation
branches.then: Confirm that all items match and submit a report.

branches.when: You use a new ingredient or new content
branches.then: Prepare data for each function and submit a review request.

situations.docs: Report or review request; existing review result notice (UV protection item); formulation data
situations.period: Review 60 days / reports are entered in the register after the requirements are confirmed

situations.q: If we change the formulation or directions of a reviewed functional cosmetic, do we need another review?
situations.conclusion: To change reviewed items, submit an amended review request for functional cosmetics to the President of the National Institute of Food and Drug Safety Evaluation, attaching the earlier review result notice and documents proving the reason for the change. For a reported item, submit the report again.

branches.when: You change the content of a reviewed item
branches.then: Submit an amended review request.

branches.when: You change the content of a reported item
branches.then: Submit the report again with the changed content.

situations.docs: Amended review request for functional cosmetics; existing review result notice; proof of the reason for the change
situations.period: In practice, it depends on the scope of the change and any supplements

situations.q: What documents do we need to transfer the rights to a reviewed functional cosmetic to another company?
situations.conclusion: When the reviewed party changes through a transfer of rights, you also submit an amended review request, attaching the transfer agreement as proof of the reason for the change.

branches.when: The acquiring company holds cosmetics responsible distributor registration
branches.then: Submit the amended review request with the existing result notice and the transfer agreement.

branches.when: The acquiring company does not yet hold responsible distributor registration
branches.then: To sell the product, it must obtain responsible distributor registration first.

situations.docs: Amended review request for functional cosmetics; existing review result notice; transfer agreement
situations.period: In practice, it depends on any supplements

situations.q: How should we respond to a supplement request in a functional cosmetics review in Korea?
situations.conclusion: First identify which standard the request concerns (the justification of raw materials and quantities, the fit of the efficacy claims to the category, or the clarity of dosage and administration), then revise and resubmit the matching data.

branches.when: Form entries or the list of submitted data are incomplete
branches.then: Organize the missing documents and entries and submit a supplement.

branches.when: The test data itself is insufficient
branches.then: Have a testing laboratory run additional tests and submit the results as supplementary data.

branches.when: The dosage and administration wording was flagged as unclear
branches.then: Revise it into clear wording that leaves no room for misuse and resubmit.

situations.docs: Supplement request; revised submission data; additional test data (where applicable)
situations.period: Review 60 days / the overall schedule extends by the time the supplement takes

glossary.def: Cosmetics within the scope set by the cosmetics laws that help with skin whitening, wrinkle improvement, UV protection or tanning, changing hair colour, removing hair or relieving hair loss, or improving weakened skin or hair function.

The functions set in eleven items by the Enforcement Rule of the Cosmetics Act: two whitening functions, wrinkle improvement, tanning, UV protection, hair colour change, body hair removal, hair-loss relief, relief of acne-prone skin, skin barrier function restoration, and relief of red stretch marks.

A procedure in which the President of the National Institute of Food and Drug Safety Evaluation receives a review request with product-specific safety and efficacy data and assesses raw materials and quantities, efficacy claims, and dosage and administration against the standards.

glossary.term: Report for items excluded from review (심사 제외 품목 보고)
glossary.def: A procedure in which, for functional cosmetics identical to a published item or identical in all respects to an already reviewed item, a report is submitted instead of a review and entered in the report register.
A review obtained again when changing reviewed items, by submitting an amended review request with the existing result notice and proof of the reason for the change.

glossary.term: Review and amended review result notice (심사·변경심사 결과통지서)
glossary.def: A document issued by the President of the National Institute of Food and Drug Safety Evaluation after the review number, product name, efficacy claims and other details are entered in the review register; it is not a "certificate".

A rule allowing items with published ingredients and content to omit origin, safety, efficacy and UV protection evidence data, and items with published specifications and test methods to omit the specifications and test methods data.
A party registered as a responsible distributor in order to distribute and sell cosmetics; it is one of the parties that can file functional cosmetics reviews and reports.
